title: Pixels To Frame
text: Convert pixel stream to frame-based video, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Video format} sets Dimensions of active regions in a video frame; {Number of components} sets the number of values used to represent each and {Number of pixels}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: pixel
ports.summary: Input pixel stream scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals associated with pixel stream pixelcontrol bus

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Indicates when output frame is ready scalar

params.name: Number of components
params.values: Number of values used to represent each pixel 1 (default) | 2 | 3 | 4

params.name: Number of pixels
params.values: Number of pixels streamed per time step 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8

params.name: Video format
params.values: Dimensions of active regions in a video frame 1080p (default) | 240p | 480p | 480pH | 576p | 720p | 768p | 1024p | 1200p | 2KCinema | 4KUHDTV | 8KUHDTV | Custom
